rationale: Dorea is proteolytic and ferments amino acids and butyrate anaerobically. With glucose depleted, I switch to butyrate + amino acid fermentation, generating acetate, formate, CO₂, and H₂ as products. Nitrogen from arginine, serine, cysteine, alanine, and ammonium supports growth. This flux is sustainable within the sealed batch and matches known Dorea metabolism.
